title: Soundtrack separation · dialogue, music and effects
description: Generated by scripts/eval/gen-cases.mjs from the research files; edit the generator, not this file. Synthetic 12 s mixes with known stems (python3 -I scripts/eval/fixtures/make-separation.py --speech <folder> --speech-licence "<source, licence>" writes them into local/separation/; the speech is yours to bring with its words and its licence, the music, effects, hum and hiss are synthesized there, CC0; the measured runs used LibriSpeech dev-clean speaker 1272, CC BY 4.0) and your own clip for the blind review. Scores each stem against its known part (SI-SDR, SDR), whether voice + bed add back up to the input, the bed's level, peak and stereo image against the known bed, where a steady hum or hiss goes, the dialogue's word error rate (Whisper base.en, pnpm eval:setup --asr; werInput is the same ASR on the input as it is, which is "Clean the voice first" off) and the speed from ComfyUI-DBS's report. Clean up dialogue (clean-dialogue: one file with the bed at −18 dB) is scored against the voice plus the known bed at that level (remixSiSdr), with the bed's level in it (bedLevel), the noise left in it and its WER. Licences (information): DBS-TIGER-DnR Apache-2.0 (JusperLee/DBS-TIGER-DnR@22da7d4c; trained on DnR v2 (CC BY 4.0), from scratch); DBS-BSRNN-DnR Apache-2.0 (JusperLee/DBS-BSRNN-DnR@5af343f5; trained on DnR v2 (CC BY 4.0), from scratch); ComfyUI-DBS MIT; MelBand RoFormer MIT; Demucs MIT; DeepFilterNet 3 MIT OR Apache-2.0; VEED Clean Audio a hosted paid API; the test mixes' sources are recorded in each mix's meta.json. SAM Audio isn't here: it is not offered on the cloud engine.
decides: Defaults change only on these numbers, in a reviewed code change: the open split's model per host (src/lib/av/split.ts) is the faster model unless the other wins dialogue SI-SDR by more than 1 dB on most mixes at a speed the host can live with (a minute of audio in under 5 minutes on a CPU); stereo stems (each channel) become the default only if the fast stereo bed loses its stereo image (bed stereo gap over 0.1) or its level (over 1 dB) on the centred mixes; the dub's voice split (src/lib/av/dub.ts DEFAULT_VOICE_SPLIT) moves to DBS when its dialogue WER is no worse than MelBand RoFormer's and its bed keeps the music and effects (background SI-SDR at least 3 dB higher).

bsrnn-mono.description: DBS-BSRNN (fast), mono: stems from the channels' mean, the bed is the original minus the speech (the fast stereo bed)

bsrnn-stereo.description: DBS-BSRNN, each channel: every channel separated on its own (twice the time for stereo)

dbs-dub.description: The dub's first step with DBS (graph B: DBS-BSRNN voice and bed, then Qwen3-ASR 0.6B on the voice)

melband.description: The dub's first step with MelBand RoFormer (a vocals model; voice and background only, then Qwen3-ASR 0.6B)

demucs.description: Demucs (htdemucs on fal, as today's cloud dub uses it): vocals against drums, bass and other, summed into the bed

clean-dialogue.description: Clean up dialogue, open (graph C: DBS-BSRNN dialogue with the music and effects at −18 dB, one file)

clean-veed.description: Clean up dialogue, cloud: VEED Clean Audio (the voice with nothing under it)

clean-deepfilternet.description: Clean up dialogue, cloud: DeepFilterNet 3 on fal (audio only; a denoiser, so music stays)
